blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Existing social bias benchmarks evaluate large language models mostly on fluent, well-formed English, reflecting native speaker usage and leaving non-native writers unrepresented. To address this gap, we investigate how grammatical errors by non-native writers affect social bias. We develop a controlled framework that injects common learner errors into prompts and apply it to three bias benchmarks covering stereotype alignment and demographic preference across gender, race, and religion. We find that grammatical errors increase bias, and the effect grows with the error rate. Among the four common error types we consider, preposition errors produce the largest and most consistent increase in stereotype alignment. Our analysis suggests that errors increase bias when they are more likely to interfere with comprehension. Finally, fine-tuning on erroneous texts reduces the bias increase caused by grammatical errors. Our findings show that bias evaluations based exclusively on well-formed prompts may underestimate the bias experienced by users whose English contains grammatical errors.
blocks.zh: 现有的社会偏见基准主要以流利而成型的英语来评价大型语言模式,反映了母语的使用,使非本地作家无人任职。 为了弥补这一差距,我们调查非本土作家的语法错误如何影响社会偏见. 我们制定了一个控制框架,将共同的学习者错误注入提示,并将其应用于三个偏见基准,包括性别、种族和宗教的定型观念调整和人口偏好。 我们发现语法错误会增加偏差,效果会随出错率而增加. 在我们所考虑的四种常见错误类型中,预置错误产生的最大和最一致地增加的定型比对. 我们的分析表明,错误如果更有可能干扰理解,就会增加偏见。 最后,对错误的文本进行微调会减少由语法错误引起的偏差增加. 我们的调查结果表明,完全基于成形提示的偏见评价可能会低估英语含有语法错误的用户所经历的偏见.

The grammatical errors shift the model’s answers towards the gender stereotype.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are known to exhibit social biases such as the reproduction of societal stereotypes and demographic discrimination, which may reflect biases encoded in their training data ( Bolukbasi et al., 2016 ) . For example, in coreference resolution an LLM may be more likely to associate a doctor with the masculine pronoun “he”, reflecting a gender stereotype about the profession. Such biases can manifest across downstream tasks and have been extensively studied across social dimensions including gender, race, and religion ( Gallegos et al., 2024 ; Zhao et al., 2018 ; Parrish et al., 2022 ; Tamkin et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 众所周知,大语言模型(LLMs)表现出社会偏见,如社会定型观念的复制和人口歧视,这可能反映其培训数据中的偏见(Bolukbasi等人,2016年)。 例如,在比较法中,LLM更可能将医生与男性代词“他”联系起来,这反映了对该职业的性别定型观念。 这种偏见可表现在下游任务中,并经过广泛的社会层面研究,包括性别、种族和宗教(Gallegos等人,2024年;Zhao等人,2018年;Parrish等人,2022年;Tamkin等人,2023年)。

blocks.en: Despite extensive research on bias in LLMs, existing works mostly measure it through well-formed, error-free text ( Nangia et al., 2020 ; Nadeem et al., 2021 ; Zhao et al., 2018 ; Parrish et al., 2022 ) , implicitly assuming a native speaker as the user. Yet, non-native (L2) speakers of English outnumber native (L1) speakers globally ( Crystal, 2003 ) , and L2 writing is more likely to contain the non-standard usage and grammatical errors typical of language learners ( Berzak et al., 2015 ) .
blocks.zh: 尽管对LLMs中的偏差进行了广泛的研究,但现有作品大多通过造型良好,没有错误的文本来测量(南吉亚等人,2020年;纳德埃姆等人,2021年;赵等人,2018年;Parrish等人,2022年),含蓄地假设一个母语为用户. 然而,非母语(L2)的英语讲者在全球超过本地(L1)讲者(Crystal,2003年),L2写作更可能包含语言学习者典型的非标准使用和语法错误(Berzak等人,2015年)。

blocks.en: Although prior work has not examined how grammatical errors affect model bias, studies show that noise in prompts can substantially alter LLM behavior ( Wang et al., 2024 ) . This suggests that grammatical errors may interact with existing model biases by altering token probabilities, reducing clarity, or increasing ambiguity of the prompt.
blocks.zh: 虽然之前的工作没有研究过语法错误如何影响模型偏差,但研究表明,在提示中的噪声可以实质性改变LLM行为(Wang等人,2024年). 这表明语法错误可能通过改变符号概率,降低清晰度,或增加提示的模糊度,与现有的模型偏差相互作用.

blocks.en: In this work, we systematically evaluate the effect of grammatical errors on bias in five open-weight LLMs, using three standard benchmarks that cover two forms of social bias across three tasks and three demographic categories (gender, race, and religion): WinoBias measures stereotype alignment in coreference resolution, BBQ in question answering, and DiscrimEvalGen measures demographic preference in decision-making.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们系统地评估了语法错误对五个开放加权法学硕士课程偏差的影响,使用了三个标准基准,涵盖三个任务和三个人口类别(性别、种族和宗教)的两种形式的社会偏差: WinoBias衡量在对等参照分辨率中的定型一致性,BBQ在回答问题时,DiscrimEvalGen衡量决策中的人口偏好。

blocks.en: Since existing bias benchmarks contain well-formed text, we develop a framework for simulating common grammatical errors in existing bias evaluation benchmarks (see Figure 1 ), while controlling the type of errors, their frequency, and their location in the prompt. Thus, our main question is whether grammatical noise affects the extent to which LLMs exhibit socially biased behavior. We address it via the following research questions: RQ1: Do L2 errors in the prompt increase social bias in LLMs compared to error-free prompts, and how does this effect vary across different forms of social bias? RQ2: How do error types and their location in the prompt affect the increase in social bias exhibited by LLMs? RQ3: Can error-aware fine-tuning mitigate the effects of L2 errors on social bias in LLMs?
blocks.zh: 由于现有的偏差基准包含完善的文本,我们开发了一个框架,用以模拟现有偏差评价基准中常见的语法错误(见图1),同时控制错误的类型,频率,以及其及时的位置. 因此,我们的主要问题是语法噪声是否影响LLMS表现出社会偏见行为的程度. 我们通过下列研究问题处理该问题: RQ1:与无错误的提示相比,LLMs的快速中L2错误是否增加了社会偏差,这种效果如何因不同形式的社会偏差而异? RQ2: 错误类型及其在即时位置如何影响 LLMs 所显示的社会偏见的增加? RQ3:错误感知微调能减轻L2错误对LLMs中社会偏见的影响吗?.

blocks.en: Contributions. (1) We introduce a controlled framework for injecting common grammatical errors into bias benchmarks; (2) we show that grammatical errors amplify both stereotype alignment and demographic preference, especially the errors most likely to interfere with comprehension, and that the increase in stereotype alignment stems from an increased reliance on stereotypes for anti-stereotypical examples; (3) we show that error-aware fine-tuning mitigates the bias increase induced by grammatical errors.
blocks.zh: 捐款。 (1)我们引入一个将常见语法错误注入偏差基准的控制框架;(2)我们显示语法错误会扩大定型调和人口偏好,特别是最可能干扰理解的错误,而定型调和的增加源于对反定型例子越来越依赖定型调和;(3)我们显示,意识到错误的微调可以减轻语法错误引起的偏差增加.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Defining and measuring social bias in LLMs. Social bias refers to systematic disparities in how a model represents or treats demographic groups ( Gallegos et al., 2024 ) , and can cause different kinds of harm, such as representational harms, e.g., reproducing stereotypes, and allocational harms, e.g., unfairly assigning opportunities ( Blodgett et al., 2020 ) .
Social bias is typically measured with curated benchmarks, each targeting a specific kind of bias through a particular evaluation task. For instance, representational bias has been evaluated through association tests ( Nangia et al., 2020 ; Nadeem et al., 2021 ) , coreference resolution ( Zhao et al., 2018 ) , and question answering ( Parrish et al., 2022 ) , while allocational bias is measured with decision tasks, e.g., approving a loan, whose outcome should not depend on the demographic group ( Tamkin et al., 2023 ) . All these benchmarks, however, are written in standard well-formed English. To our knowledge, no prior work systematically measures how grammatical errors that are typical of L2 writers affect social bias in LLMs.
blocks.zh:
界定和衡量法学硕士的社会偏见。 社会偏见是指在模式如何代表或对待人口群体方面存在的系统性差异(Gallegos等人,2024年),并可能造成不同种类的伤害,如代表性伤害,如再现陈规定型观念,分配伤害,如不公平分配机会(Blodgett等人,2020年)。
衡量社会偏见的标准一般是经过整理的基准,每个基准都通过特定评价任务针对特定类型的偏见。 例如,通过协会测试(Nangia et al.,2020;Nadeem et al.,2021),coreference resolution(Zhao et al.,2018),以及问答(Parrish et al.,2022)来评价代表偏差,而分配偏差则通过决策任务来衡量,例如批准贷款,其结果不应取决于人口群体(Tamkin et al.,2023). 然而,所有这些基准都用标准、完善的英语写成。 据我们所知,以前的工作没有系统地衡量典型的L2作家的语法错误如何影响LLMs中的社会偏见。

blocks.en:
Impact of linguistic variation on NLP tasks. The English variety a user writes alters LLM outputs: Fleisig et al. (2024) find that responses to minoritized varieties are more stereotyping and demeaning than responses to standard ones.
Prejudice against African American English drives covert discrimination on employability and criminality that persists despite overt debiasing ( Hofmann et al., 2024 ; Blodgett and Talat, 2024 ) . Nativeness has a comparable impact: Reusens et al. (2025) find that LLM accuracy on classification tasks varies with the user’s nativeness, and that merely stating it anchors the model’s answers, even when false.
In downstream applications, GPT detectors falsely flag human-written L2 essays as machine-generated, which the authors attribute to their lower perplexity ( Liang et al., 2023 ) .
However, none of these studies measures how this variation affects the demographic bias that benchmarks are designed to elicit. Closest to our method, Wang et al. (2024) inject five types of noise, including grammatical and typographical errors, into prompts and find that performance drops significantly, although some models resist certain types of noise; their target, though, is task accuracy rather than social bias.
blocks.zh:
语言差异对NLP任务的影响. 用户所写的英语品种会修改 LLM 输出: Fleisig等人(2024年)发现,对次要品种的反应比对标准品种的反应更具陈规定型观念和贬低性.
对非裔美国人英语的偏见导致在就业能力和犯罪方面隐蔽的歧视,尽管公开贬低,但这种歧视仍然存在(Hofmann等人,2024年;Blodgett和Talat,2024年)。 原生性具有相似的影响:Reusens等人(2025年)发现,分类任务的LLM精度随用户的原生性而不同,仅仅声明它支撑着模型的答案,即使是假的.
在下游的应用中,GPT探测器将人写的L2散文错误地标注为机器生成,作者将此归结为他们的低迷(Liang等人,2023年).
然而,这些研究都没有衡量这一变化如何影响基准设计所要引发的人口偏见。 最接近于我们的方法,王等人(2024年)将包括语法错误和打字错误在内的五种噪音注入提示,发现性能显著下降,虽然有些模型抵制某些类型的噪音;虽然他们的目标是任务准确性而非社会偏见.

blocks.en:
Simulating L2 errors. Synthetic error generation has been commonly used for supervised training and finetuning of grammatical error correction systems Kiyono et al. (2019) ; Kaneko et al. (2020) ; Palma Gomez et al. (2023) ; Náplava and Straka (2019) , where manually-corrected data from L2 writers is expensive to obtain.
To simulate learner errors, previous studies made use of a variety of approaches.
These include noise-based approaches, such as character-level perturbations Kiyono et al. (2019) and spellchecker-based confusions Grundkiewicz et al. (2019) ; translation-based approaches, such as back-translation Xie et al. (2018) ; Kiyono et al. (2019) and round-trip translation Lichtarge et al. (2019) ; and linguistically-inspired rules that operate on individual tokens based on their part-of-speech and the respective morphological transformations Choe et al. (2019) .
blocks.zh:
模拟 L2 错误 。 合成错误生成通常用于对语法错误校正系统Kiyono等人(2019年);Kaneko等人(2020年);Palma。 Gomez等人(2023年); Náplava and Straka (2019年),其中L2作家手动校正的数据价格昂贵.
为了模拟学习者的错误,以前的研究使用了多种方法.
其中包括基于噪声的方法,如字符级扰动 Kiyono等人(2019年)和基于拼写检查器的混淆(Grundkiewicz等人(2019年);基于翻译的方法,如回译. 谢等人(2018年);基约诺等人(2019年)和圆通译Lichtarge等人(2019年);以及基于其部分语义和各自形态变换在单个代币上操作的语言启发规则. Choe et al. (2019) (英语).

blocks.en:
For all these approaches, it is crucial that the generated errors represent as closely as possible naturally occurring learner errors Náplava and Straka (2019) . Realistic learner errors can be grounded in annotated learner corpora ( Yannakoudakis et al., 2011 ; Dahlmeier et al., 2013 ; Bryant et al., 2019 ) .
Indeed, comparisons with human-corrected learner corpora that contain naturally occurring L2 errors show that these methods are capable of imitating real learner errors; however, the approaches are complementary in the type of error they imitate best and in the degree to which the rate and the type of errors can be controlled.
In this work, we adopt this idea and apply synthetic error generation for constructing bias benchmarks for our study and we develop our framework using the approach based on linguistic rules and parts-of-speech that allows us to control the type, frequency and location of the resulting mistakes.
blocks.zh:
对所有这些方法来说,产生的错误必须尽可能密切地反映自然发生的学习者错误Náplava和Straka(2019年)。 现实主义的学习者错误可以基于附加说明的学习者公司(Yannakoudakis等人,2011年;Dahlmeier等人,2013年;Bryant等人,2019年)。
事实上,与含有自然发生的L2错误的经人修正的学习者公司(corpora)的比较表明,这些方法能够模仿真正的学习者错误;然而,这些方法在它们所模仿的最好错误类型以及控制速度和错误类型的程度方面是相辅相成的。
在这项工作中,我们采纳了这一想法,并采用合成错误生成法来构建我们的研究的偏差基准,我们利用基于语言规则和语言部分的方法来制定我们的框架,从而使我们能够控制由此产生的错误的类型,频率和位置.

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: We adopt a controlled perturbation approach: rather than designing new prompts, we take well-established social bias benchmarks written in error-free English and systematically inject common learner errors into them. This design isolates linguistic noise as the sole independent variable, allowing us to directly measure how L2 errors alter a model’s baseline social bias.
blocks.zh: 我们采取一种有控制的干扰方法:我们不设计新的提示,而是采用用没有错误的英语写成的既定的社会偏见基准,并系统地将共同的学习者错误注入其中。 这种设计将语言噪声孤立为唯一的独立变量,使我们能够直接衡量L2错误如何改变模型的基线社会偏差.

blocks.en: Our methodology has two components: the benchmarks, which cover different social biases and task formulations (§sec:benchmarks), and a rule-based perturbation framework that simulates L2 writing (§sec:error_generation). Using synthetic errors rather than real learner text lets us independently control the type , rate , and location of the errors. All perturbed prompts are generated offline prior to inference, so every model is evaluated on identical inputs.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法有两个组成部分:涵盖不同社会偏见和任务表述的基准(§sec:bencmarks)和模拟L2写作的规则扰动框架(§sec:error_generation). 使用合成错误而不是真正的学习者文本让我们可以独立控制错误的类型,率和位置. 所有扰动的提示在推论前都会产生离线,因此每个模型都以相同的输入值来评价.

blocks.en: 3.1 Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 3.1 基准

blocks.en: We leverage three standard benchmarks that capture two distinct forms of social bias: (i) stereotype alignment , defined as the tendency of a model to perpetuate societal stereotypes, and (ii) demographic preference , defined as the systematic favoring of one demographic group over another. For brevity, we use the term “bias” to refer to both forms throughout the paper unless specified otherwise. Our evaluation spans three tasks (coreference resolution, question answering, and decision-making) and three demographic categories ( gender , race , and religion ). Detailed benchmark descriptions and examples from each dataset are in §apx:deep_bench.
blocks.zh: 我们利用三项标准基准,抓住两种不同的社会偏见:(一) 定型观念的结合,即一种模式使社会定型观念永久化的倾向;(二) 人口偏好,即有系统地偏爱一个人口群体而不是另一个人口群体。 为了简洁起见,除非另有说明,否则我们使用“偏见”一词来指整个文件的两种形式。 我们的评估涉及三个任务(参照解答、问答和决策)和三个人口类别(性别、种族和宗教)。 每个数据集的详细基准描述和示例在§apx:deep_bench中.

blocks.en:
WinoBias ( Zhao et al., 2018 ) measures stereotype alignment in coreference resolution, focusing exclusively on gender . Each test item presents a sentence with two occupations historically associated with opposing genders (e.g., “doctor” vs. “nurse”) and a pronoun. Sentences are evaluated in counterfactual pairs: a pro-stereotypical scenario (where the pronoun matches societal expectations, e.g., resolving “he” to “doctor”) and an anti-stereotypical one (where the pronoun violates them, e.g., resolving “he” to “nurse”). Bias is quantified via the historical bias score ( B = Acc pro − Acc anti B=\text{Acc}_{\text{pro}}-\text{Acc}_{\text{anti}} ), defined as the difference between accuracy on pro-stereotypical and anti-stereotypical examples, measuring the extent to which the model relies on societal stereotypes to resolve the task.
An example of how the model is prompted is provided in 2 .
blocks.zh:
WinoBias(赵等人,2018年)在校对决议中衡量陈规定型观念的一致,专门侧重于性别问题。 每个试验项目都有一个句子,包含两个历史上与性别对立有关的职业(例如“医生”对“护士”)和一个代词。 判决按相反事实对等来评价:一种亲定型情景(即代词符合社会期望,例如解决“他”到“医生”的问题)和一种反定型情景(即代词违反,例如解决“他”到“护士”的问题)。 Bias通过历史偏差分数(B = Acc pro = Acc – Acc antext{Acc {Acc}_{\text{pro}}-\text{Acc}_{\text{anti}}})量化,定义是亲定型和反定型型例子的精度差异,衡量模型在多大程度上依靠社会定型来解决任务.
以2为例说明该模型是如何激发的。

blocks.en:
BBQ Parrish et al. (2022) evaluates stereotype alignment in a Question-Answering format and covers nine social dimensions. We specifically focus on the gender , race , and religion splits of the benchmark. Each test item provides the model with a context and a question (e.g., “who was the secretary?”) along with three possible answers: pro-stereotypical (e.g., “the woman”), anti-stereotypical (e.g., “the man”), and neutral (e.g., “unknown”). Following Marcuzzi et al. (2026b) , we drop the neutral option to enforce a choice between the pro-stereotypical and anti-stereotypical answers.
The benchmark features both ambiguous contexts (lacking factual evidence) and disambiguated contexts (providing sufficient evidence); bias is measured on the ambiguous contexts (examples of both are in 3 and 4 , respectively).
Bias is quantified via the stereotype score : B = ( n pro − n anti ) / ( n pro + n anti ) B=(n_{\text{pro}}-n_{\text{anti}})/(n_{\text{pro}}+n_{\text{anti}}) , where n pro n_{\text{pro}} and n anti n_{\text{anti}} denote the count of pro-stereotypical and anti-stereotypical responses selected by the model.
blocks.zh:
BBQ 数据 Parrish等人(2022年)以问答形式评价定型观念的一致,并涵盖9个社会层面。 我们特别注重基准的性别、种族和宗教分裂。 每个试验项目都向模型提供上下文和问题(如“谁是秘书?”)以及三种可能的答案:亲定型(如“妇女”)、反定型(如“男子”)和中立型(如“未知”)。 在Marcuzzi等人(2026年b)之后,我们放弃了中立的选择,在亲定型和反定型的答案之间强制进行选择.
基准既包括模棱两可的背景(缺乏事实证据),也包括模棱两可的背景(提供足够的证据);偏颇是以模棱两可的背景来衡量的(两者的例子分别是3和4)。
偏见通过定型分数量化: B = (n pro – n 反) / (n pro + n 反) B=(n_{\text{pro}}-n_{\text{anti}}})/(n_{\text{pro}}+n_{\text{anti}}}),其中n pr_{\text{pro}}}和n ant_{\text{anti}}表示模型选择的亲定型和反定型反应的计数.

blocks.en:
DiscrimEvalGen ( DE-Gen ; Kirsten et al., 2025 ) complements the two representational bias benchmarks by measuring allocational fairness , i.e., demographic discrimination in decision-making: the model must assign an advantageous scenario (e.g., granting a benefit or opportunity) to candidate demographic groups.
We use the gender , race , and religion splits of the benchmark. Following Marcuzzi et al. (2026b) , we binarize choices into pairwise comparisons between a historically advantaged and a historically disadvantaged group (male vs. female for gender, White vs. Black for race, and Christian vs. Muslim for religion).
Here, bias is quantified via the demographic parity gap : B = ( n disadv − n adv ) / ( n disadv + n adv ) B=(n_{\text{disadv}}-n_{\text{adv}})/(n_{\text{disadv}}+n_{\text{adv}}) , where n disadv n_{\text{disadv}} and n adv n_{\text{adv}} represent the number of selections favoring historically disadvantaged and advantaged groups.
An example prompt is provided in 5 .
blocks.zh:

blocks.en: 3.2 Generating Synthetic Errors
blocks.zh: 3.2 生成合成错误

blocks.en: We adopt the synthetic error generation method that relies on part-of-speech and linguistic knowledge Choe et al. (2019) . We chose the approach since it allows us to control for the types of errors to inject, location in prompt, and the error frequency.
blocks.zh: 我们采用合成错误生成方法,这种方法依赖于部分语言和语言知识Choe等人(2019年)。 我们选择了这个方法,因为它使我们能够控制各种类型的错误以迅速注入,位置和错误频率。

blocks.en: Type of errors. To mimic naturally-occurring learner mistakes, we inject synthetic errors of four types that are among the most frequent in learner-English corpora (FCE, Yannakoudakis et al., 2011 ; NUCLE, Dahlmeier et al., 2013 ; W&I+LOCNESS, Bryant et al., 2019 ): determiner, preposition, verb (including tense, form, and agreement), and spelling errors. Together, these errors account for 37-43% of the annotated edits in these corpora, as reported by Bryant et al. (2019) ( Table B.2 ).
blocks.zh: 错误的类型。 为了模仿自然发生的学习者错误,我们注入了四种类型的合成错误,这些错误在学习者-英语公司(FCE, Yannakoudakis等人,2011年;NUCLE, Dahlmeier等人,2013年;W&I+LOCNESS,Bryant等人,2019年):确定者,预设,动词(包括紧张,形式和同意),以及拼写错误. 如Bryant等人(2019年)报告的那样,这些错误加在一起占了这些公司注释编辑的37-43%(表B.2)。

blocks.en:
Both determiner and preposition errors involve operations of three types (deletion, replacement, or insertion of a closed-class word). We use error distributions from the learner corpora to draw the choice of each operation in the appropriate proportion (§apx:error_types). For verb errors, similarly, we sample the error sub-type (tense, form, or agreement) according to its frequency in learner corpora and replace the verb with a corresponding inflection (e.g., talk , talks , talking , talked ) generated with pyinflect 2 2 2 https://pypi.org/project/pyinflect/ , v0.5.1. .
Finally, we introduce spelling errors following Náplava and Straka (2019) : a token is replaced, with equal probability, by an orthographically close dictionary word suggested by GNU Aspell 3 3 3 http://aspell.net , v0.60.8. or by a non-word misspelling obtained with one character-level operation (deletion, insertion or substitution of an adjacent key, transposition, consonant doubling, vowel confusion).
blocks.zh:
确定器和预置错误都涉及三种类型的操作(删除,替换,或插入闭类词). 我们使用学习者corpora的错误分布来绘制每个操作的选择比例(§apx:error_types). 对于动词错误,同样,我们根据学习者corpora的频率,对错误子类型(强度,形式,或协议)进行抽样,并用对应的动词(如谈话,交谈,交谈,交谈)替换为pyinflect 2 2 2 https://pypi.org/project/pyinflect/,v0.5.1.
最后,我们提出Náplava和Straka(2019年)之后的拼写错误: a 符号在概率相等的情况下,被GNU Aspell 3 3 3 http://aspell.net.v0.60.8.建议的一个正字形接近的字典词所取代,或者通过一个字符级操作(删除、插入或替换相邻的密钥、转位、对齐翻转、元音混淆)获得的非字形错拼。

blocks.en:
For determiner, preposition, and verb errors, token eligibility is determined by the part-of-speech tags assigned by spaCy 4 4 4 https://spacy.io , v3.8.16. ( DET , ADP , and VERB / AUX , respectively), whereas spelling errors can affect any alphabetic token that is neither protected nor already modified.
Candidates that are gender words, protected entities, or proper nouns are excluded. Lastly, when multiple errors are introduced together, their relative frequencies are also determined based on the distribution in the learner corpora. Further details on error generation are provided in §apx:deep_error.
blocks.zh:
对于确定者,预设,和动词错误,符号资格由spa分配的语音部分标记决定. Cy 4 4 4 https://spacy.io ,v3.8.16.(分别为DET,ADP,和VERB / AUX),而拼写错误会影响任何既不受保护也未经修改的字母符号.
性别词语、受保护实体或适当名词的候选人被排除在外。 最后,当多个错误一起引入时,它们的相对频率也根据学习者corpora的分布来确定. 关于错误生成的进一步详情,请参见§apx:deep_error.

blocks.en:
Error location. A prompt consists of an instruction (task description and answer format, identical across all items) and an input (the benchmark item itself). 1 illustrates an example of error generation for each location. We perturb either component individually or both simultaneously, yielding three evaluation scenarios:
(1) instruction , simulating a non-native user drafting custom instructions for clean input data;
(2) input , simulating the processing of L2-written input text using standard instructions; and
(3) both , simulating a non-native user drafting the entire prompt.
To avoid completely impairing the model’s ability to comprehend the task, protected prompt components are never modified.
Note that, to isolate the difference in accuracy due to the stereotype alignment of the sentence and not to different errors, for WinoBias, the counterfactual sentences in a pair share the exact same edits.
blocks.zh:
错误位置 。 提示包含一个指令(任务描述和回答格式,在所有项目中都相同)和一个输入(基准项目本身). 1 说明了每个地点产生错误的例子。 我们单独或同时扰动两个部分,得出三种评价设想:
(1) 指令,模拟非本地用户为清洁输入数据起草定制指令;
(2) 输入,模拟使用标准指示处理L2-书面输入文本;以及
(3)两者,模拟非本地用户起草整个提示.
为了避免完全损害模型理解任务的能力,保护的即时组件永远不会被修改.
请注意,由于句子的定型对齐而非不同的错误,为了隔离准确度的差异,对于WinoBias,一对中的反事实句子共享完全相同的编辑.

blocks.en:
Error rate. We control the intensity of the perturbation through the token error rate of a prompt, ε = d ⁡ ( x , x ~ ) / n \varepsilon=d(x,\tilde{x})/n , where d d is the token-level Levenshtein distance ( Levenshtein, 1966 ) between the clean text x x and its perturbed version x ~ \tilde{x} , and n n is the number of tokens outside the protected spans; we report ε \varepsilon as a percentage.
We consider four error levels, ℓ ∈ { 5 , 10 , 20 , 30 } % \ell\in\{5,10,20,30\}\% , chosen to span the error rates observed in learner corpora, which are typically 10-20% of the tokens ( Bryant et al., 2019 ) .
Since the generator can only modify tokens of the appropriate part of speech, ε \varepsilon cannot be set directly: for every benchmark, error type, and prompt part, we calibrate the fraction of eligible tokens the generator modifies until the mean error rate ε ¯ \bar{\varepsilon} over all prompts of the benchmark is within one percentage point of ℓ \ell (when the four types are injected together, ℓ \ell is split among them in proportion to their shares in learner corpora), and we discard the levels that cannot be reached (e.g., determiner errors cannot exceed ε ¯ ≈ 28 % \bar{\varepsilon}\approx 28\% in the instruction). We write ε ~ = ℓ \tilde{\varepsilon}=\ell for the resulting condition, with ε ~ = 0 \tilde{\varepsilon}=0 denoting the clean prompt. Calibration details are given in §apx:calibration.
4 Experiments and Results
blocks.zh: 4 实验和结果

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We structure our experiments by first ( RQ1 ) examining the effect of grammatical errors on social bias (§sec:genr_eff), then ( RQ2 ) the impact of each error type (§sec:type_err) and error locations (§sec:scope_err). Next, we investigate the mechanisms driving this bias amplification (§sec:acc_bias), and finally ( RQ3 ) propose a mitigation strategy via error-aware fine-tuning (§sec:finetuning).
blocks.zh: 我们的实验结构首先(RQ1)检查语法错误对社会偏差(§sec:genr_eff),然后(RQ2)每个错误类型(§sec:type_err)和错误位置(§sec:scope_err)的影响. 其次,我们调查推动这种偏差放大的机制(§sec:acc_bias),最后(RQ3)通过误差感知微调(§sec:fineturning)提出缓解策略.

blocks.en:
Unless otherwise specified, experiments default to the gender category with all four error types simultaneously injected into the prompt’s input .
The reason for this choice is that gender is the only demographic axis shared across all three benchmarks, allowing us to compare trends across them.
Moreover, since the four error types co-occur in real L2 writing, this setting makes the evaluation closer to a realistic scenario.
blocks.zh:
除非另有说明,否则所有四种错误类型的实验都默认为性别类别,同时注入提示输入中。
作出这一选择的理由是,性别是所有三个基准共用的唯一人口轴心,使我们能够比较它们之间的趋势。
此外,由于真实的L2写法中有四种错误类型共同存在,这种设置使得评价更接近现实的情景.

blocks.en: Models. We evaluate five open-weight models from three families: Qw2.5-7B, Qw2.5-14B, Qw2.5-32B, Mis3.2-24B, and LMa3.1-8B (more details in Table D.1 ). This allows us to test whether the effect of L2 errors holds across models, rather than being specific to a single architecture or size. Decoding settings are provided in §apx:hyper.
blocks.zh: 模特儿们 我们评价三个家庭的5个开放重量模型:Qw2.5-7B、Qw2.5-14B、Qw2.5-32B、Mis3.2-24B和LMa3.1-8B(详见表D.1)。 这使得我们可以测试L2错误的效果是否在模型之间存在,而不是对单个架构或大小的特定. 解码设置在 §apx: hyper 中提供.

blocks.en: Mitigating positional bias. To mitigate the tendency of LLMs to select an option based on its position rather than its content ( Pezeshkpour and Hruschka, 2024 ) , we query the model using both option orders (e.g., “A: carpenter, B: housekeeper” and “A: housekeeper, B: carpenter”). By sampling five generations per prompt, we evaluate a total of ten answers for each benchmark item.
blocks.zh: 减轻位置偏差. 为了缓解LLMs根据其位置而不是其内容选择一个选项的倾向(Pezeshkpour和Hruschka, 2024年),我们使用两种选项命令(如“A:木匠、B:管家”和“A:管家、B:木匠”)对模型提出质疑。 通过对每秒5代人的抽样,我们总共评估了每个基准项目的10个答案。

blocks.en: Metrics. All metrics range in [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] and are reported multiplied by 100 100 . For WinoBias and BBQ, 1 1 and − 1 -1 indicate a tendency to select the stereotypical and the anti-stereotypical option, respectively; for DE-Gen, they denote a preference toward historically disadvantaged and advantaged groups. A score of 0 0 indicates an unbiased model: one whose performance is independent of the stereotypical cue in WinoBias, with no systematic preference between options in BBQ, and achieving demographic parity (fairness) in DE-Gen.
blocks.zh: 度量衡. 所有度量范围在[− 1, 1] [-1, 1] 中,并报告乘以 100 100。 对于WinoBias和BBQ, 1 1和 − 1 分别表示倾向于选择陈规定型和反定型的选择;对于DE-Gen来说,它们表示倾向于历史上处于不利地位和处于优势的群体。 得分0表示一种没有偏见的模式:其表现独立于WinoBias的定型提示,在BBQ的选项和DE-Gen的实现人口均等(公平)之间没有系统的偏好.

blocks.en: Statistical significance. Statistically significant differences from the clean baseline ( α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 ) are highlighted in bold in tables and with solid dots in figures. Significance is determined via a paired approximate randomization test ( Riezler and Maxwell III, 2005 ) , with full details in §apx:stattest.
blocks.zh: 统计意义. 与清洁基准(α = 0.05\alpha = 0.05)之间的统计性显著差异在表格中以粗体显示,并在数字中以实点表示。 通过对齐的近似随机化测试(Riezler and Maxwell III, 2005 )来确定意义,在§apx:statest中包含全部细节.

blocks.en: 4.2 Key Results
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 主要结果

blocks.en: Table 1 reports model bias on gender when the four types of error are injected together in the input at increasing error levels ε ~ ∈ { 5 , 10 , 20 , 30 } % \tilde{\varepsilon}\in\{5,10,20,30\}\% ( Table E.1 presents results on race and religion). We combine the four error types following their distribution in learner writing ( Table B.2 ) to approximate naturally occurring learner errors. Across the three benchmarks, grammatical errors in the input increase both stereotype alignment and demographic preference, and the increase grows with the error level . The effect is most pronounced on WinoBias: the bias rises monotonically for most models and is statistically significant at the higher error levels; it is similar but less regular on BBQ, where significance is reached mainly at ε ~ ≥ 20 % \tilde{\varepsilon}\geq 20\% . For DE-Gen the trend still holds for some models, but is statistically significant only at ε ~ = 30 % \tilde{\varepsilon}=30\% .
blocks.zh: 表1报告在不断上升的误差水平上输入四类误差时对性别的模型偏差。 (表E.1列出种族和宗教方面的结果)。 我们把四个错误类型在学习者写作(表B.2)的分布之后合并起来,以大致了解自然发生的学习者错误。 在三个基准中,输入中的语法错误既增加了定型观念的一致,也增加了人口偏好,而且随着错误程度的增加而增加。 对WinoBias的影响最为明显:对于大多数模型来说,偏差是单调的,在较高的误差水平上具有统计意义;对于BBQ来说,这种偏差是相似的,但不太常见的,其意义主要在 ~ ~ 20%\ tilde\varepsilon\ 20\ 。对于DE-Gen来说,趋势对于一些模型来说仍然维持,但统计意义只有 ~ ~ = 30%\ tilde\varepsilon\ 30\ 。

blocks.en:
Regarding bias direction, on WinoBias a positive shift means that the models resolve the pronoun correctly more often when the referent matches the gender stereotype than when it contradicts it.
On the ambiguous contexts of BBQ, where no correct answer is supported by the text, models select the stereotypical answer increasingly more often than the anti-stereotypical one as errors accumulate.
Regarding fairness, on DE-Gen all models already favor the historically disadvantaged group (the female) on clean prompts, and errors reinforce this preference for most of them.
This is a different phenomenon from stereotype alignment: errors do not push the models toward the historically advantaged group, but amplify a pre-existing preference, moving them further away from demographic parity.
blocks.zh:
关于偏见的方向,在WinoBias上,一个积极的转变意味着,当参照人与性别定型观念相符时,模型更经常地正确解决代词问题,而不是与之矛盾时。
关于BBQ的模棱两可的情况,如果文本没有支持正确的答案,模型比反陈规定型的答案更多地选择定型答案,因为错误累积。
在公平方面,在DE-Gen方面,所有模式都已经有利于历史上处于不利地位的群体(女性)在干净的提示上,错误加强了大多数模式的偏好。
这是一种不同于陈规定型的调整现象:错误不会将模型推向历史上处于优势的群体,而是会扩大原先存在的偏好,使它们更远离人口均等。

blocks.en: For race and religion , the same tendencies appear with lower intensity and less consistency across models and levels ( Table E.1 ): the shifts toward the stereotypical answer on BBQ and toward the disadvantaged groups (Black and Muslim) on DE-Gen are significant only in a few cases, and some models move in the opposite direction.
blocks.zh: 在种族和宗教方面,同样的倾向以较低强度和不同模式和不同层面的一致性出现(表E.1):向BBQ和DE-Gen弱势群体(黑人和穆斯林)的定型答案转变只在少数情况下是显著的,有些模式朝着相反的方向发展。

blocks.en: Key finding: The more errors an L2 speaker makes, the more likely they are to receive a stereotypically aligned answer or an answer with a stronger preference for one demographic group.
blocks.zh: 关键结果 : L2发言者犯的错越多,他们就越有可能得到一个陈规定型的答案或一个更倾向于一个人口群体的答案。

blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 错误类型的效果

blocks.en: Our next experiment investigates how each type of grammatical error contributes to the increase in bias. To this end, we independently inject each error type into the input while keeping the overall error level constant across conditions. Figure 2 shows the results for Qw2.5-14B and Mis3.2-24B (all models are shown in Table E.2 ).
blocks.zh: 我们接下来的实验研究了每一种语法错误是如何促使偏差增加的. 为此,我们独立地将每个错误类型注入输入中,同时在各种条件之间保持总体错误水平不变. 图2显示Qw2.5-14B和Mis3.2-24B的结果(所有模型见表E.2)。

blocks.en: On WinoBias, preposition errors have the largest effect on stereotype alignment for every model, followed by verb and spelling errors, while determiner errors have the smallest effect. At the same error rate, preposition errors alone increase bias on WinoBias more than the four error types combined. On BBQ, preposition and verb errors tend to have the strongest effect, but the ranking varies across models. On DE-Gen no single error type produces a consistent trend: only determiner errors reach statistical significance, for a few models and at isolated error levels.
blocks.zh: 在WinoBias上,前置错误对每个模型的定型对齐影响最大,其次是动词和拼写错误,而确定者错误的影响最小. 在相同的误差率下,仅前置误差就比四个误差类型加在一起的WinoBias上偏差更大. 在BBQ上,前置和动词错误往往效果最强,但排名因模型而异. 在DE-Gen上,没有单一错误类型产生一致的趋势:只有确定者错误达到统计意义,对于少数模型和孤立的错误级别.

blocks.en:
The strong effect of preposition errors is noteworthy because prepositions are particularly challenging for L2 learners, including those with advanced proficiency, due to their high semantic ambiguity and context-dependent usage patterns in English ( Leacock et al., 2014 ) . Moreover, prepositions encode semantic relationships between sentence constituents, so their incorrect use is more likely to alter or confuse the meaning of the sentence Choshen et al. (2020) .
These properties may explain why preposition errors have a particularly strong effect on bias: in §apx:comprehension we show that the error types that degrade comprehension the most are those that increase bias the most ( r = 0.76 r=0.76 ).
blocks.zh:
姿势前置错误的强烈效果值得注意,因为姿势前置对于L2学习者,包括那些具有高级熟练程度的学习者来说,由于语义模糊度高,而且英语的使用模式依赖上下文(Leacock等人,2014年). 此外,预置句子成分之间的编码语义关系,因此其不正确的使用更可能改变或混淆句子Choshen等人(2020年)的含义.
这些属性可能解释为什么前置错误对偏差有特别强烈的影响:在 §apx:理解中,我们显示,降解理解度最高的错误类型是增加偏差度最高的错误类型(r = 0.76 r = 0.76).

blocks.en: Figure 3: Bias on WinoBias as a function of error level and error location (instruction, input, or both).
blocks.zh: 图3:作为错误水平和错误位置(指令,输入,或两者兼有)函数的WinoBias上的偏差.

blocks.en: 4.4 The Effect of the Error Location
blocks.zh: 4.4 (中文(简体) ). 错误位置的影响

blocks.en:
Figure 3 compares the effect of injecting the four error types into the instruction, the input, or both, for WinoBias (all models and benchmarks are shown in Table E.3 ).
The results demonstrate that errors in the input amplify the bias, whereas, in most cases, errors confined to the instruction do not .
We conjecture that because the instruction has the same content for all items and conveys no instance-specific information, corrupting it does not alter which answer the errors favor; rather, the critical factor is the text in which the demographic contrast is expressed.
Injecting errors in both parts yields values close to the input condition and often slightly below it. We hypothesize that errors in both parts impair the comprehension of the task as a whole, so that the models also fail more often on pro-stereotypical sentences than with errors in the input only, which narrows the bias gap.
On BBQ, this separation is less pronounced. On DE-Gen, no injection location produces a consistent effect.
blocks.zh:
图3比较了将四种错误类型注入指令、输入或两者的效果(所有模型和基准见表E.3)。
结果显示,输入中的错误会扩大偏差,而在多数情况下,仅限于指令的错误不会。
我们推测,由于该指示对所有项目都有相同的内容,而且没有传递具体实例的信息,因此腐败不会改变哪些答案偏好错误;相反,关键因素是表达人口对比的文本。
两部分的注入错误产生接近输入条件的值,并往往略低于输入条件. 我们假设,两部分的错误都会损害对整个任务的理解,因此模型在亲定型句子上也会更经常的失败,而不是只输入错误,这缩小了偏差差距.
在BBQ上,这种分离不太明显. 在DE-Gen上,没有注射位置产生一致的效果.

blocks.en: 4.5 Why L2 Errors Exacerbate Social Bias
blocks.zh: 4.5 为什么L2错误 Excerbate Social Bias

blocks.en: In §sec:genr_eff we showed that L2 errors increase social bias and that, on WinoBias, this means the errors degrade the resolution of anti-stereotypical sentences more than that of pro-stereotypical ones. In this section, we investigate why this happens, looking at the accuracy on the two types of sentences and at the reasoning of the models. We focus on WinoBias, the only benchmark on which stereotype alignment and task accuracy are measured on the same items: the bias is the gap Acc pro − Acc anti \text{Acc}_{\text{pro}}-\text{Acc}_{\text{anti}} between the resolution accuracies on pro- and anti-stereotypical sentences.
blocks.zh: 在§sec:genr_eff中,我们显示L2错误会增加社会偏见,在WinoBias上,这意味着错误比亲定型错误更能降解反定型句子的解析. 在本节中,我们调查为什么发生这种情况,研究两类句子的准确性以及模型的推理. 我们侧重于WinoBias, 这是在同一项目上衡量定型调和和任务准确性的唯一基准:偏差是Acc pro – Acc 反文本{Acc {Acc}_{\text{pro}}-\text{Acc}_{\text{anti}在赞成和反对定型句子的决议中的空隙。

blocks.en: Table 2 reports the two accuracies separately. Under errors, the accuracy of every model decreases on both types of sentences, but the loss concentrates on the anti-stereotypical ones: an accuracy loss spread evenly over the two types would leave the bias unchanged. In other words, under errors the models lose little when the correct referent matches the stereotype, and much more when it contradicts it. This indicates that when the errors degrade comprehension, models do not answer at random but default more often to the stereotypical association . In §apx:acc_general we further show that this additional loss does not occur on tasks where no stereotype offers an alternative answer, i.e., the models fail when a stereotype is available to fall back on.
blocks.zh: 表2分别报告了这两个情况。 在错误下,每种模型的准确度在两种句子上都下降,但损失集中在反定型:在两种类型上均匀分布的精度损失将使偏差保持不变. 换句话说,在错误下,模型在正确参照者与定型观念相符时损失很少,在与之相矛盾时损失更多。 这表明,当错误降低理解时,模型不会随机回答,而是更经常地默认定型关联。 在 §apx:acc_general中,我们进一步表明,这种额外损失不会发生在没有定型观念提供替代答案的任务上,即当存在定型观念时,模型失败。

blocks.en: Table 3: A WinoBias pair for Mis3.2-24B, with anti-stereotypical pronoun “him” and pro-stereotypical pronoun “her”, both with identical errors at ε ~ = 30 % \tilde{\varepsilon}=30\% . The model answers correctly on the clean anti-stereotypical sentence and on the errored pro-stereotypical one, but on the errored anti-stereotypical one it picks the stereotypical occupation. Next to each answer, its count out of 10 generations; excerpts come from a generation with the majority answer.
blocks.zh: 表3:Mis3.2-24B的WinoBias配对,带有反定型代词“Him”和亲定型代词“Him”,两者在X ~ = 30%\tilde\varepsilon ~ 30 = 时都有相同的错误。 该模型正确回答干净的反定型句子和错误的亲定型句子,但错误的反定型句子却选择了定型占领. 每一个答案的旁边,它从十代人中计数出来;节录来自一代人,多数人回答.

blocks.en: Table 3 illustrates this fallback on the stereotype for Mis3.2-24B, on a sentence pair whose pro- and anti-stereotypical versions receive identical errors (the four types at ε ~ = 30 % \tilde{\varepsilon}=30\% ), so that they differ only in the pronoun; Table E.4 reports similar pairs for the other four models, one at each analyzed error level. On the clean prompt, the model resolves the anti-stereotypical sentence from the structure of the sentence: the carpenter is the one who helps, so “him” refers to the housekeeper . With the same errors, it still resolves the pro-stereotypical version correctly, which shows that the corrupted sentence remains interpretable; in the anti-stereotypical version, instead, it attaches the pronoun to the carpenter and justifies the choice with the gender stereotypically associated with the two occupations (“the term housekeeper typically refers to a female entity, while carpenter refers to a male entity”). The rationales of the other models follow the same pattern: when the errors obscure the structure of the sentence, the models invoke either the stereotype or a role heuristic (e.g., “the laborer is the one who typically works harder”). The reasoning thus confirms what the accuracies suggest: the stereotype replaces the sentence structure as the cue for resolving the pronoun.
blocks.zh: 表3以Mis3.2-24B的定型观念来说明这种倒退,在一对句子上,支持和反对定型的版本得到相同的错误(4种类型在 ~~ = 30%\tilde\varepsilon ~ 30 ~ ),因此它们只在代名词中有所不同;表E.4报告其他4种模型的类似对子,每一种分析错误级别. 在干净的提示上,模型从句子结构中解决了反定型的句子:木匠是帮助者,所以"他"指的是管家. 同样的错误,它仍然正确地解决了支持定型的版本,这说明腐败的句子仍然可以解释;反定型的版本则将代词归结于木匠,并以与两种职业相关的性别定型选择(管家一词一般指女性实体,而木匠则指男性实体). 其他模型的原理也遵循同样的模式:当错误模糊了句子的结构时,模型会引用定型或角色修饰(例如,“劳工是通常更努力工作的人”)。 由此推论证实了"快感"所暗示的:定型取代句子结构作为解决代词的提示.

blocks.en: 4.6 Mitigation via Error-Aware Fine-Tuning
blocks.zh: 4.6 通过错误识别减轻影响

blocks.en: Figure 4: Effect of error-aware fine-tuning on LMa3.1-8B. Base is the original model; FT clean and FT errors are the same model fine-tuned on WinoGrande with clean and with errored prompts, respectively. Solid dots mark statistically significant differences from the clean prompt.
blocks.zh: 图4:误觉微调对LMa3.1-8B的影响. Base是原型;FT clean和FT错误在WinoGrande上是同一型号的微调,分别带有干净和错误的提示. 固体点与干净的提示在统计学上显著不同。

blocks.en: In §sec:acc_bias we argued that the bias increase reflects a loss of comprehension. If this is the case, a model that has learned to read text with L2 errors should rely less on stereotypes when it encounters them. To test this hypothesis, we fine-tune LMa3.1-8B with LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) on WinoGrande ( Sakaguchi et al., 2021 ) , a commonsense task structurally close to WinoBias, from which we remove every item containing an explicit gender word or a WinoBias occupation, so as not to debias the model directly on the associations we evaluate, which would confound the analysis. The targets are the model’s own correct answers on the clean prompts, and we train two adapters on the same targets: FT errors , whose prompts contain the four error types at a level drawn per item from { 5 , 10 , 20 , 30 } % \{5,10,20,30\}\% , and FT clean , whose prompts are clean. The two models therefore differ only in their exposure to errors (details in §apx:finetuning).
blocks.zh: 在§sec:ac_bias中,我们提出,偏见的增加反映了理解的丧失。 如果是这样的话,一个学习过用L2错误阅读文本的模型在遇到这些错误时,应该少依赖刻板印象. 为了测试这个假设,我们微调了LMa3.1-8B与LORA(Hu等人,2022年)在WinoGrande(Sakaguchi等人,2021年)上,这个常识任务在结构上接近WinoBias,我们从中去除了每个含有明确性别词或WinoBias职业的项目,以免直接贬低我们所评价的协会的模型,这将混淆分析. 目标就是模型自己在干净的提示上的正确答案,我们用同样的目标来训练两个适配器: FT错误,其提示包含从{5, 10, 20, 30} 的每个项目抽取的四种错误类型,% QQ 5, 10, 20, 30\}\%, FT干净,其提示是干净的。 因此,这两种模型仅在暴露出错误方面有所不同(详见§apx:fineturn)。

blocks.en: Figure 4 shows that training on errored text reduces the bias increase induced by the errors . On BBQ, the bias of Base and FT clean grows with the error level, whereas that of FT errors does not; on WinoBias, FT errors still shows an increase, but a smaller one. The difference in the increase is significant against both models on BBQ and against FT clean on WinoBias (§apx:finetuning). The accuracy plots show where the difference comes from: FT errors retains more accuracy on the anti-stereotypical sentences, i.e., it falls back on the stereotype less often when the sentence contradicts it. On MMLU, the fine-tuning leaves the clean accuracy unchanged, but the robustness does not transfer to this task.
blocks.zh: 图4显示,关于错误文本的培训减少了错误引起的偏差增加。 在BBQ上,Base和FT clean的偏差随着错误级别而增加,而FT错误的偏差则没有;在WinoBias上,FT错误仍然显示增加,但较小. 相对于BBQ和WinoBias的FT清洁两种模型(§apx:fineturn),增加的差别很大. 精度图显示了区别来自何方: FT错误在反定型句子上保留了更多的精度,即当句子与定型句相矛盾时,它会较少地回到定型句上. 在MMLU上,微调使干净的精度保持不变,但坚固度并没有转移到这个任务上.

blocks.en: Learning to read errored text, with the same target answers, makes the model rely less on stereotypes under L2 errors.
blocks.zh: 学习读取错误的文本,具有相同的目标答案,使得模型在L2错误下较少依赖陈规定型观念.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We investigate how grammatical errors typical of L2 writing affect social bias in LLMs, extending bias evaluation beyond the well-formed English assumed by standard benchmarks.
We find that grammatical errors generally increase social bias, with the effect growing with the error rate. Furthermore, among the four error types, preposition errors have the largest effect on stereotype alignment, which we attribute to the semantic change they introduce compared to errors that only affect syntax. The increase in bias is associated with a disproportionate loss of accuracy on anti-stereotypical examples, suggesting that degraded comprehension leads models to rely more heavily on stereotypical associations. Finally, we propose error-aware fine-tuning, which removes the bias increase on BBQ and reduces it on WinoBias.
blocks.zh:
我们调查L2写作典型的语法错误如何影响LLMs中的社会偏差,将偏差评价扩展到标准基准假设的完善的英语之外.
我们发现语法错误一般会增加社会偏见,其影响随错误率而增加. 此外,在四种错误类型中,预置错误对定型对调影响最大,我们将其归因于它们引入的语义变化与仅影响语法的错误相比. 偏见的增加与反陈规定型例子的准确性丧失不成比例有关,这表明理解的退化导致模型更加依赖陈规定型的结合。 最后,我们提议对错误认识进行微调,从而消除对BBQ的偏差增加,减少对WinoBias的偏差.

blocks.en: Our findings show that linguistic variation is an important factor in evaluating social bias in LLMs, and that improving model robustness to such variation can also reduce the social biases encountered by linguistically diverse users.
blocks.zh: 我们的调查结果表明,语言差异是评估法学硕士课程中社会偏见的一个重要因素,改进模型稳健性以达到这种差异还可以减少语言多样性使用者遇到的社会偏见。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: While our study provides novel insights into the interaction between L2 writing and LLM bias, several limitations should be acknowledged.
blocks.zh: 虽然我们的研究对L2写作与LLM偏差之间的相互作用提供了新的见解,但应该承认一些局限性。

blocks.en: Synthetic Error Injection. First, our error-injection pipeline relies on rule-based synthetic perturbations calibrated to learner corpora distributions. While this design is essential to guarantee strict experimental control over error type, rate, and location (allowing for causal inference), real-world L2 writing is inherently more complex. Natural non-native text frequently involves interlanguage phenomena, discourse-level awkwardness, word-order permutations, and L1-specific syntactic transfers that our synthetic rules may not fully capture. We do not validate the realism of the injected errors with human judgments or with text written by L2 writers.
blocks.zh: 合成错误注射. 首先,我们错误注入管道依赖于基于规则的合成扰动校准到学习者公司分布. 虽然这种设计对于保证严格实验性地控制错误的类型,速率和位置(允许因果推论)至关重要,但现实世界的L2写法本质上更为复杂. 自然非本土文本经常涉及语言间现象,语境层面尴尬,词序排列,以及L1特异性合成转移,我们合成规则可能无法完全抓住. 我们无法用人类判断或L2作家撰写的文字来证实注入错误的现实主义。

blocks.en: Scope of Linguistic Errors. Second, our analysis is constrained to four prevalent error categories (determiners, prepositions, verbs, and spelling). Future work should explore a broader spectrum of linguistic disruptions, including punctuation noise, lexical choice errors (e.g., false friends), and larger multi-word phrasing anomalies.
blocks.zh: 语言错误的范围。 第二,我们的分析限于四个常见的错误类别(决定因素、预设、动词和拼写)。 未来的工作应该探索语言中断的更广泛的范围,包括发音噪声,词典选择错误(如假朋友),以及更大的多词的词组异常.

blocks.en: Template-Based Benchmarks. Third, our evaluation focuses on three primary demographic dimensions (gender, race, and religion) within standard template-based benchmarks (WinoBias, BBQ, DE-Gen). While these datasets are standard baselines in the literature and allow for a controlled measurement of bias, they do not encompass the full complexity of intersectional biases or the nuances of open-ended, free-form chat interactions, where bias might manifest more subtly.
blocks.zh: 基于模板的基准。 第三,我们的评价侧重于基于标准模板的基准(WinoBias、BBQ、DE-Gen)的三个主要人口层面(性别、种族和宗教)。 虽然这些数据集是文献中的标准基线,并允许对偏差进行有控制的衡量,但它们并不包含交叉偏差的全部复杂性或开放式的自由形式聊天互动的细微差别,其中偏差可能更隐蔽地表现出来.

blocks.en: Restriction to Open-Weight Models. Finally, our analysis was conducted exclusively on open-weight models of up to 32B parameters. This decision was driven by budget constraints. For the same reason, the error-aware fine-tuning is tested on a single model.
blocks.zh: 限制开放-重量型号. 最后,我们的分析完全针对最多32B参数的开放重量模型。 这一决定是由于预算限制。 出于同样的原因,误觉微调在单一模型上进行测试.

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en:
Our error-injection framework covers four types of learner errors, whereas real L2 writing contains many more. A model that shows little bias increase under our errors should therefore not be assumed to show little bias increase in real use, where the effect may be larger than what we measure. Likewise, our findings rest on three benchmarks, and caution is needed when generalizing them to other tasks and demographic groups.
The framework could also be used to craft prompts that elicit more stereotypical answers; we release it to support the evaluation of robustness, and the perturbations it produces are the same that ordinary users make unintentionally. Finally, our findings concern a population that is already disadvantaged in its access to language technologies: they should be read as a shortcoming of the models, which should be robust to the way L2 speakers write, and not as a reason to expect these speakers to adapt their writing.
blocks.zh:
我们的错误注入框架包括四种类型的学习者错误,而真正的L2写入则包含更多. 因此,不应假定一个在我们的错误下显示微弱偏差的模型在实际使用上显示微小偏差的增加,因为实际使用的效果可能大于我们所衡量的效果。 同样,我们的调查结果基于三个基准,在将其归纳到其他任务和人口群体时需要谨慎。
该框架还可以用来制定引起更陈规定型答案的提示;我们发布该框架以支持对稳健性的评价,其产生的扰动与普通用户无意中作出的相同。 最后,我们的调查结果涉及一个在获得语言技术方面已经处于不利地位的人口:应把他们看作是模型的一个缺点,它应该与L2发言者的写法保持一致,而不是作为期望这些发言者修改其写作的理由。

blocks.en: This section details the three bias benchmarks and MMLU, on which the models are evaluated, and WinoGrande, used for fine-tuning; Table A.1 lists them together with their licenses, references, and download links. All of them were built to probe social bias or to measure model capabilities, so we use them for the purpose they were designed for. Our only intervention is the injection of learner errors into the prompts, described in §sec:error_generation, which leaves the protected spans listed below untouched.
blocks.zh: 本节详细列出了三个偏差基准和MMLU(对模型进行评估),以及用于微调的WinoGrande;表A.1列出了这些基准和MMLU及其许可证、参考文献和下载链接。 它们都是为了探究社会偏差或测量模型能力而建造的,所以我们用它们来达到它们设计的目的. 我们唯一的干预措施是将学习者的错误注入第§sec:error_generation中描述的提示中,使以下所列受保护的跨度保持不变。

blocks.en:
WinoBias ( Zhao et al., 2018 ) targets gender bias in coreference resolution, restricted to the male and female groups. Each sentence mentions two occupations and one gendered pronoun; according to U.S. labor statistics, the pronoun matches the stereotype of one occupation and contradicts that of the other, and each sentence comes in a pro-stereotypical and an anti-stereotypical version. The task is to decide which of the two entities the pronoun refers to.
We adopt the test set, and since the true referent is known, the benchmark also yields a resolution accuracy.
The error generator never touches the two occupations, the pronoun, or the answer options. 2 shows an example of a clean prompt, while 1 shows a prompt with the four error types injected at ε ~ = 10 % \tilde{\varepsilon}=10\% .
blocks.zh:
WinoBias(赵等人,2018年)在校对解析中针对性别偏见,仅限于男性和女性群体. 每个句子都提到两个职业和一个性别化的代词;根据美国劳工统计,代词与一个职业的定型相匹配,与另一个职业相矛盾,每个句子都以亲定型和反定型的版本出现. 任务是决定代词所指的两个实体中的哪个实体.
我们通过测试集,由于真正的参照者是已知的,基准也得出分辨率的准确性.
错误生成器从不触及两个职业,即代词或答案选项. 2 显示了一个干净的快捷键的例子, 而 1 显示了一个快捷键, 与 QQ ~ = 10%\ tilde\varepsilon ~ 10\ 的 4 个错误类型 。

blocks.en: BBQ ( Parrish et al., 2022 ) measures how often a model falls back on stereotypes when answering multiple-choice questions. It comes in two splits. In the ambiguous split the context is deliberately under-specified, so no answer can be grounded in the text; in the disambiguated split the same contexts are completed with the evidence needed to identify the correct answer. Bias is measured on the ambiguous split, whereas the disambiguated one, where the correct answer is known, is used only to measure the accuracy of the models under errors.
blocks.zh: BBQ(Parrish等人,2022年)衡量一个模型在回答多选题时如何经常回到定型观念上. 分两分来. 在模棱两可的分裂中,上下文被刻意忽略,因此文字中不能基于任何答案;在混沌分裂中,用识别正确答案所需的证据完成同样的上下文. Bias是用模棱两可的分法来衡量的,而模棱两可的分法,即知道正确答案的分法,仅用于在错误下测量模型的准确性.

blocks.en: Among the demographic categories covered by the benchmark, we keep gender , race , and religion , and we measure how often the model picks the stereotypical answer. Each question originally offers three options, namely a stereotypical, an anti-stereotypical, and a neutral one; as in Marcuzzi et al. (2026b) , we drop the neutral option so that the model must choose between the first two. This choice does not affect the evaluation: in the ambiguous split the two remaining options are exactly the stereotypical and the anti-stereotypical answers on which bias is measured, and in the disambiguated split the correct answer is always one of them, so accuracy remains well defined. The demographic mentions in the context, the question, and the answer options are protected from error injection. 3 shows a clean prompt from the ambiguous split, and 4 the same prompt in its disambiguated version.
blocks.zh: 在基准涵盖的人口类别中,我们保留性别、种族和宗教,我们衡量模型如何经常选择定型答案。 每个问题最初都有三种选择,即陈规定型、反定型和中性;如Marcuzzi等人(2026年b)中,我们放弃中性选择,以便模式必须在前两个选择之间作出选择。 这一选择并不影响评价:在模棱两可的分裂中,剩下的两个选择恰恰是用来衡量偏见的陈规定型和反定型答案,在模糊的分裂中,正确的答案总是其中之一,因此准确性仍然得到很好的界定. 上下文中的人口统计、问题和答案选项都受到保护,不会出现错误。 3显示从模棱两可的分裂中产生的干净的提示,而4则显示其模糊的版本中相同的提示.

blocks.en: DiscrimEvalGen ( DE-Gen ; Kirsten et al., 2025 ) is the generative variant of DiscrimEval ( Tamkin et al., 2023 ) : the model faces a decision scenario in which answering positively is always the favorable outcome, and fairness is assessed by contrasting its decisions across demographic groups. There is no correct answer in this benchmark: the two groups are interchangeable, so any systematic preference for one of them is a bias. We adopt the version of the benchmark released by Marcuzzi et al. (2026b) , who binarized the original choice into a comparison between two groups, namely male and female for gender, Black and White people for race, and Muslim and Christian for religion. Each prompt presents the two groups as the two answer options; the group mentions, the question, and the options are protected from error injection. We report bias as the preference for the historically disadvantaged group, so positive values indicate that the female, the Black person, or the Muslim person is favored. 5 shows a clean prompt.
blocks.zh: DiscrimEvalGen(DE-Gen;Kirsten等人,2025年)是DiscrimEval的基因变种(Tamkin等人,2023年): 该模式面临一种决策情景,即积极回答总是有利的结果,公平性通过不同人口群体之间的决策对比来评估。 这个基准没有正确的答案:两组是可互换的,所以任何系统偏好其中一个就是偏偏. 我们采用Marcuzzi等人(2026年b)发布的基准版本,他将最初的选择二元化为两个群体之间的比较,即男女性别、黑人和白人种族、穆斯林和基督教宗教。 每个提示将这两个组作为两个答案选项;该组提及,问题,选项都受到保护,不会被错误注入. 女性、黑人或穆斯林受到青睐。 5显示一个干净的提示。

blocks.en: MMLU ( Hendrycks et al., 2021 ) tests general knowledge and reasoning through four-option multiple-choice questions drawn from 57 subjects, each with a single correct answer. Errors are injected in the question and in the lines that introduce it, with the same procedure as in the bias benchmarks, but never in the answer options; accuracy is computed over the answered generations. 6 shows a clean prompt.
blocks.zh: MMLU(Hendrycks et al., 2021)通过从57个科目中抽取的四选项多选题来测试一般知识和推理,每题都有一个正确的答案. 错误被注入问题和引入问题的行中,其程序与偏差基准相同,但在答案选项中从未出现;准确性是按被回答的几代人计算的。 6 显示一个干净的提示。

blocks.en:
WinoGrande ( Sakaguchi et al., 2021 ) tests commonsense reasoning through sentences in which a blank must be filled with one of two entities mentioned in the sentence; the sentences come in twin pairs that differ in a trigger word that flips the correct answer. We use it only for the error-aware fine-tuning of §sec:finetuning:
its training split ( winogrande_xl , 40,398 items) provides the training data, and its validation split (1,267 items) serves as a held-out check (§apx:finetuning). We discard every item whose sentence or options contain an explicit gender word or one of the 40 occupations of WinoBias, so as not to debias the model directly on the associations we evaluate; this leaves 27,903 training and 880 validation items.
Each item is rendered with the same two-option prompt format as WinoBias, in both orders of the options; the two entities and the question are protected from error injection. 7 shows a clean prompt.
blocks.zh:
WinoGrande(Sakaguchi等人,2021年)通过句子测试常识推理,在句子中,一个空白必须填充句子中提到的两个实体之一;句子是双对的,在触发词中不同,可以翻转正确答案. 我们只用它来修正 §sec:fineturn:
其培训拆分(winogrande_xl,40,398项)提供了培训数据,其验证拆分(1,267项)充当了搁置检查(§apx:fineturning). 我们放弃每个含有明确性别词或WinoBias40种职业之一的句子或选项的项目,以免直接从我们评价的协会身上抹去模型;这就留下了27,903个培训和880个验证项目。
每个项目都以WinoBias相同的双选项快速格式在两个选项的顺序中提供;两个实体和问题都受到保护,不会被错误注入。 7显示一个干净的提示。

blocks.en: Protected spans are the demographic entities, the WinoBias pronouns, the question, the answer options, and the \boxed{} answer format. The two prompts of a counterfactual pair receive identical edits, so that they still differ only in the demographic attribute; the instruction, although shared by all items, is perturbed independently for each pair. Generation is deterministic given a seed.

blocks.en: B.2 Calibration of the Error Rate

blocks.en: In the token error rate ε = d ⁡ ( x , x ~ ) / n \varepsilon=d(x,\tilde{x})/n , the number of tokens n n is counted on the longer of the clean and perturbed texts, so that ε \varepsilon does not exceed 100%. The generator modifies a given fraction of the eligible tokens, i.e., the tokens of the appropriate part of speech. For every benchmark, error type, and prompt part, we tune this fraction by bisection until the mean error rate ε ¯ \bar{\varepsilon} over all prompts of the benchmark satisfies | ε ¯ − ℓ | ≤ 1 |\bar{\varepsilon}-\ell|\leq 1 percentage point. We discard the levels that cannot be reached even when every eligible token is modified; for instance, determiner errors cannot exceed ε ¯ ≈ 28 % \bar{\varepsilon}\approx 28\% in the instruction, whereas preposition and spelling errors reach every level. When the four error types are injected together, ℓ \ell is split among them in proportion to their shares in FCE ( Table B.2 ), and a common scaling factor of the four fractions is then tuned in the same way, so that the combined ε ¯ \bar{\varepsilon} is within one percentage point of ℓ \ell . The error rate is measured and calibrated separately on the instruction and on the input; the condition with errors in both parts applies the two calibrated configurations, so it is exactly the union of the two single-part conditions.

blocks.en: Appendix C Extra Analysis
blocks.zh: 附录C 额外分析

blocks.en: C.1 Comprehension Loss by Error Type
blocks.zh: C.1 按错误类型分列的理解损失

blocks.en: Table C.1: Loss of accuracy on the pro- and anti-stereotypical sentences of WinoBias and increase of the bias at ε ~ = 30 % \tilde{\varepsilon}=30\% with respect to the clean prompt, by error type injected in the input, averaged over the five models.
blocks.zh: 表C.1: 国家 在WinoBias的赞成和反定型句上失去准确性,在\\ = 30%\ tilde\varepsilon\ = 30\ 的偏差上,通过输入中注入的误差类型,在5种模型上均值.

blocks.en: To verify that the error types that interfere more with comprehension are those that increase bias more (§sec:type_err), we take the accuracy loss on the pro-stereotypical sentences of WinoBias as a measure of how much each error type degrades comprehension, since §apx:acc_general shows it to be comparable to the loss on tasks not tied to a stereotype. Table C.1 reports it next to the bias increase. The single error types rank in the same order on both: prepositions, verbs, spelling, determiners; across models, single error types, and levels ( n = 80 n=80 ), the two quantities have a Pearson correlation of 0.76 0.76 ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ). Preposition errors stand out: they degrade comprehension less than the four types combined ( 4.1 4.1 vs. 4.8 4.8 points) but increase the bias more ( 8.2 8.2 vs. 5.0 5.0 ), because their loss falls disproportionately on the anti-stereotypical sentences ( 12.4 12.4 vs. 9.8 9.8 points), consistent with their role in encoding the relations between constituents, the cue on which anti-stereotypical resolution depends.
blocks.zh: 为了验证那些更干扰理解的错误类型是那些增加偏差(§sec:type_err)的错误类型,我们把维诺比亚斯亲定型句的准确性损失作为衡量每个错误类型降解理解程度的一个尺度,因为 §apx:ac_general 显示它可以和不与定型挂钩的任务的损失相比. 表C.1报告了偏见增加的情况。 单个错误类型在两种类型上排列在同一顺序:前位、动词、拼写、确定者;跨模型、单一错误类型和级别(n = 80 n = 80),两种数量之间的皮尔逊相关性为0.76 0.76 (p < 0.001 p < 0.001 ). 预设错误突出:它们比四种类型的组合(4.1 vs 4.8 = 4.8 分)降低理解度,但增加了偏差(8.2 8.2 vs 5.0 5.0分),因为它们的损失不成比例地落在反定型句(12.4 12.4 vs 9.8 = 9.8分)上,这与它们在编码成份关系中的作用一致,即反定型解所依赖的提示。

blocks.en: C.2 Accuracy on Tasks Not Tied to a Stereotype
blocks.zh: C.2 对未绑定为定型的任务的精确性

blocks.en: Table C.2: Accuracy on MMLU and BBQ (disambiguated). Statistically significant differences from the clean prompt are marked in bold ( p < 0.05 p<0.05 ).
blocks.zh: 表C.2: MMLU和BBQ的精确度(含糊不清)。 与清洁便条的显著统计差异用粗体标出(p < 0.05 p < 0.05)。

blocks.en: A possible objection to the analysis of §sec:acc_bias is that the accuracy loss on WinoBias merely reflects a general degradation of comprehension. To rule it out, we measure accuracy under the same errors on tasks whose correct answer is not tied to a stereotype: MMLU, which contains no demographic content, and the disambiguated split of BBQ, where the context states the correct answer ( Table C.2 ). On both, L2 errors lower accuracy only moderately: at ε ~ = 30 % \tilde{\varepsilon}=30\% the loss ranges from 2.9 to 4.6 points on MMLU and from 0.0 to 4.6 points on BBQ, comparable to the loss on pro-stereotypical WinoBias sentences (3.5 to 5.8 points, Table 2 ), where the correct answer coincides with the stereotypical association. On anti-stereotypical sentences, where the correct answer contradicts the stereotype, the loss is roughly twice as large (8.7 to 11.3 points). The errors therefore degrade comprehension only moderately in general; the additional loss appears precisely where a stereotype offers an alternative answer.
blocks.zh: 对§sec:ac_bias分析的可能反对意见是,Winobias的准确性损失只是反映了理解的普遍退化。 为了排除这种情况,我们用同样的错误衡量正确答案与定型观念不挂钩的任务的准确性:没有人口内容的MMLU,以及BBQ的分化,其上下文说明了正确的答案(表C.2)。 在这两种情况下,L2差错的准确度只有中度:在X ~ = 30%\ tilde\varepsilon + 30 + 中,MMLU的损失在2.9至4.6分之间,在BBQ的损失在0.0至4.6分之间,与亲陈规定型的WinoBias句子的损失(3.5至5.8分,表2)相当,正确答案与定型关联相吻合。 在反定型的句子上,如果正确答案与定型相反,则损失大约是大(8.7到11.3分)的两倍. 因此,这些错误在一般意义上只是轻而易举地降低了理解;在定型观念提供替代答案的情况下,额外损失似乎恰好如此。

blocks.en: C.3 Error-Aware Fine-Tuning
blocks.zh: C.3 错误- 识别精细图解

blocks.en: This section describes how we build the training data and train the two fine-tuned models of §sec:finetuning. The dataset, WinoGrande, is described in §apx:deep_bench.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍我们如何构建培训数据,并培训两个精细调整模式的§sec:fineturn. 数据集WinoGrande在§apx:deep_bench中描述.

blocks.en:
From the filtered training split of WinoGrande, we sample a subset of 5,000 5{,}000 items and render each of them in both orders of the options to mitigate positional bias, for a total of 10,000 10{,}000 prompts. The targets are generated by the model itself. For each clean prompt, we sample three completions with the same decoding settings as in the evaluation (temperature 0.7 0.7 and top- p p 0.9 0.9 ) and a limit of 1,024 1{,}024 tokens, and keep the first completion whose answer is correct. We cut it right after its first \boxed{} answer and discard it if it is shorter than 80 80 or longer than 4,000 4{,}000 characters, contains more than one boxed answer, or is highly repetitive. This yields 8,978 8{,}978 training examples.
We use the model’s own reasoning as the target, rather than the gold answer alone, so that the fine-tuning preserves the chain-of-thought format used in the evaluation and changes only the inputs the model is exposed to.
blocks.zh:
从WinoGrande过滤后的训练分裂中,我们抽取了5000个5{,}000个子集,使每个子集在两个选项的顺序中都能够减轻位置偏差,总计有10,000个10{,}000个提示. 目标由模型本身产生. 对于每个干净的快件,我们抽取了三个完成件,其解码设置与评价中相同(温度0.7 0.7和顶端-p 0.9 0.9),限制为1,024 1{,}024令牌,并保留第一个完成件的答案正确. 我们在第一个\boxedQQ回答后把它剪掉,如果它短于80 80或超过4,000 4{,}000个字符,包含一个以上的框答案,或者高度重复的话。 这产生了8,978 8{,}978个培训实例。
我们把模型本身的推理作为目标,而不是金子答案,这样微调就可以保留评价中使用的思维链格式,只改变模型接触到的投入.

blocks.en:
The FT errors data use the same 8,978 8{,}978 targets, with each prompt replaced by its errored version. The errors are generated with the procedure described in §sec:error_generation: the four error types are injected together in the input, and the protected spans are the same as in the evaluation.
For each item, the error level is drawn uniformly from { 5 , 10 , 20 , 30 } % \{5,10,20,30\}\% and shared by its two prompts, which receive the same edits.

We fine-tune both models with LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) (rank 16 16 , scaling factor 32 32 , dropout 0.05 0.05 ) on all attention and MLP projections, for one epoch with a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , a cosine schedule, and an effective batch size of 16 16 . The loss is computed on the completion only. We use the 880 filtered validation items of WinoGrande as a held-out check: the accuracy of Base , FT clean , and FT errors is 61.5, 62.6, and 63.8 on clean prompts and 53.9, 55.1, and 59.0 with the four error types at ε ~ = 30 % \tilde{\varepsilon}=30\% , where FT errors is significantly more accurate than both other models ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ).
blocks.zh: 我们用LORA(Hu等人,2022年)对两种模型进行微调(排名16 16, 缩放系数32, 辍学率0.05 0.05), 损失仅在完工时计算。 我们用WinoGrande的880个过滤验证项目作为搁置检查:Base、FT clean和FT错误的准确度分别为61.5、62.6和63.8,在清洁提示上分别为53.9、55.1和59.0,其中4个错误类型为X=30%\tilde\varepsilon\30\\\,FT错误的准确度明显高于其他两个模型(p < 0.001 p < 0.001)。

blocks.en: FT clean and FT errors share the targets, their order, the hyperparameters, and the random seed. The only difference is that the prompts of FT clean contain no errors. FT clean therefore accounts for any effect of fine-tuning that is unrelated to the errors, such as the shorter generations induced by targets that end right after the answer. Both models are evaluated exactly as the base model, on the same prompts, with the same injected errors and the same decoding settings.
blocks.zh: FT干净和FT错误分享目标,它们的顺序,超参数以及随机种子. 唯一的区别是FT clean的提示没有错误. 因此,FT clean说明与错误无关的任何微调效果,例如由目标引发的较短的代数,在回答后结束。 两种模型都与基准模型完全相同,在相同的提示上,有相同的注射错误和相同的解码设置.

Values of FT errors that differ significantly from FT clean are in bold , those that differ significantly from Base are marked with † ( p < 0.05 p<0.05 ).

blocks.en: Table C.3 compares FT errors with the other two models in two ways, both with the paired test of §apx:stattest: the bias at ε ~ = 30 % \tilde{\varepsilon}=30\% , which tells which model is less biased under errors, and the increase in bias from the clean prompt to ε ~ = 30 % \tilde{\varepsilon}=30\% , which separates the effect of the errors from the bias on clean prompts. The relevant comparison is with FT clean , which differs from FT errors only in the errors seen during training, whereas Base also differs in every other effect of the fine-tuning. On WinoBias and BBQ, FT errors is significantly less biased than both other models at ε ~ = 30 % \tilde{\varepsilon}=30\% , and its increase is significantly smaller than that of FT clean ; against Base , the increase is significantly smaller only on BBQ. blocks.en: D.1 Settings and Hyperparameters

blocks.en: All models are prompted as plain text, without their chat template. Inference runs with vLLM in bf16, with temperature 0.7 0.7 and top- p p 0.9 0.9 ; for each prompt, we sample five generations of at most 2,000 2{,}000 new tokens. The random seed is fixed both for sampling and for error injection, so that the errored prompts and the generations can be reproduced. The answer of a generation is the option that is boxed the most among those provided in the prompt; generations that box none of these options, or two of them equally often, are counted as unanswered.
blocks.zh: 所有模型都作为纯文本提示,没有他们的聊天模板. 推论在bf16中以vLLM运行,温度为0.7 0.7,最高0.9页;对于每个速率,我们对五代最多2000 2{,}000个新令牌进行抽样. 随机种子既用于取样,也用于错误注射,这样误差的提示和代代可以复制. 一代人的答案是,在迅速提供的选择中,被框列得最多的选择;一代人没有这些选择,或者其中的两个选择同样经常被算作没有得到答复。

blocks.en: D.2 Statistical Significance
blocks.zh: D.2 统计意义

blocks.en: We assess differences with a paired approximate randomization test ( Riezler and Maxwell III, 2005 ) . Each unit is an item observed under the two conditions being compared, e.g., the clean and an errored prompt; under each condition, the value of the item is computed on its two prompts, with the two orders of the options (on its single prompt, for MMLU). In each of 10,000 10{,}000 permutations, we swap the two conditions of every item with probability 0.5 0.5 . The two-sided p p -value is ( c + 1 ) / ( 10,000 + 1 ) (c+1)/(10{,}000+1) , where c c is the number of permutations whose mean difference is at least as large, in absolute value, as the observed one, and we reject the null hypothesis at α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 . When we compare the effect of the errors between two models, the value of each item is its change from the clean to the errored prompt.
blocks.zh: 我们用一个对齐的近似随机化测试来评估差异(Riezler和Maxwell III, 2005.). 每个单元都是在比较的两个条件下观察到的项目,例如干净的和错误的提示;在每一个条件下,物品的值按其两个提示计算,两个选择顺序(单提示,用于MMLU). 在10000 10{,}000 个排列中, 我们以 0. 5 的概率换换每个项的两个条件。 双侧 p - 值为 (c + 1) / (10,000 + 1) (c+1)/(10{,}000+1),其中 c 是其平均差值至少与观测到的差值一样大,绝对值的位数,我们拒绝α = 0.05\alpha = 0.05的空假说. 当我们比较两个模型之间错误的影响时,每个项目的价值是它从干净的到错误的提示的改变.

blocks.en: D.3 Computational Cost and Infrastructure
blocks.zh: D.3 计算成本和基础设施

blocks.en: We conduct our experiments on a compute cluster equipped with NVIDIA H200 GPUs (141GB VRAM each), with each model served on a single GPU. Including preliminary runs, the total computational effort for all experiments and evaluations amounts to approximately 700 GPU-hours, as recorded by the job scheduler. We evaluate all models using the vLLM library ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们进行一个配备有NVIDIA H200 GPU(每台141GB VRAM)的计算集群的实验,每个模型都服务在一个GPU上. 包括初步运行,所有实验和评价的计算工作总时数约为700GPU小时,由工作调度员记录。 我们利用vLLM库(Kwon等人,2023年)评估所有模型。
